Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of SiO2-supported Pd–Au alloy catalysts with different Pd/Au ratios showed the diffraction peaks due to Au(111) and Pd(111) appearing at 2θ = 38.3 and 40.1, respectively. In the spectra of Pd–Au alloy catalysts, the peaks appeared between the two original peaks and shifted to a lower angle with a decrease in the Pd/Au atomic ratio. (Figure 1 in the report)
